---
title: "Agent Frameworks"
---

## Overview

Agent frameworks provide the software infrastructure required to build,
orchestrate, and manage AI agents.

They provide abstractions for:

-   agent loops
-   tool calling
-   state management
-   workflows
-   memory integration
-   multi-agent coordination
-   evaluation

Instead of manually building every component, frameworks provide
reusable patterns for developing agent systems.


## Framework Categories

  Category                  Purpose
  ------------------------- -----------------------------------------
  Agent Orchestration       Build and control agent workflows
  Multi-Agent Frameworks    Coordinate multiple agents
  Data-Centric Frameworks   Build agents around knowledge retrieval
  Enterprise Frameworks     Production-focused agent systems

## Framework Selection Criteria

Choosing an agent framework depends on the requirements of the system being built.

A major design decision is how much control the developer wants over the agent behaviour.

| Approach | Description | Advantages | Limitations |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fixed workflows | Developer defines the execution path | Predictable, easier debugging, safer | Less flexible |
| Graph-based agents | Developer defines states and transitions | High control while allowing adaptation | More engineering effort |
| Autonomous agents | Agent decides most actions dynamically | Flexible, powerful for exploration | Harder to evaluate and control |

##### Example:

```text
Production system:
More control → predictable behaviour

Research prototype:
More autonomy → explore agent capabilities
```
